title: E-mails (outbox) and booking PDFs, then a signed download
caption: Use cases write notifications rows inside their tenantTx and ask for documents; the worker renders and sends outside any transaction (src/notifications, src/documents; OADR-0013). Mailpit shows every local e-mail at http://127.0.0.1:8025.

steps.label: OutboxService.enqueue in the business transaction: notifications (pending, dedupe_key, secrets encrypted)
after commit: notify {tenantId}; document.render {tenantId, bookingId, kind, bookingVersion[, ticketId]}
documents: read booking (travellers' document type + last 4 only), brand, square logo, reference names
booking_documents ready (older version superseded); failure → failed row, BullMQ retries
notify: claim ≤ 100 due rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (5-min lease on next_attempt_at), commit
template: tenant notification_templates row (locale) else code default templates/<key>.*.hbs; brand.*, storefront URL, links from secrets
From "<brand>" <MAIL_FROM>, Reply-To support e-mail, attachments (ready itinerary / receipts)
sent (secret_payload_ciphertext purged, secrets_purged_at) | retry later | failed
verify signature in constant time, stream the PDF (403 FORBIDDEN when expired or altered)
